# ZayPick

> ZayPick is a hand-picked Amazon deals site. It lists the best Amazon deals
> across Electronics, Fashion, Home, Beauty, Sports and Toys, with real prices,
> ratings and review counts. ZayPick does NOT sell or ship anything — every
> "Buy on Amazon" button goes to Amazon, where the purchase, shipping and
> returns are handled by Amazon.

- Site: https://zaypick.vercel.app/
- Contact: hello@zaypick.com
- Prices shown are as of 2026-11-23. Prices change on Amazon — always check the current price on Amazon before buying.
- Disclosure: As an Amazon Associate, ZayPick earns from qualifying purchases. This costs the buyer nothing extra.

## How to find products

- All deals: https://zaypick.vercel.app/shop
- By category: https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/electronics
  https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/fashion
  https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/home
  https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/beauty
  https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/sports
  https://zaypick.vercel.app/category/toys
- Single product: https://zaypick.vercel.app/product/<product-slug>
- Buying guides: https://zaypick.vercel.app/guides
- Sitemap: https://zaypick.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
